changes: First-first and last-last changes only exact same valid contract on adjacent intended request dates, each with no unresolved clock/identity conflict and sourceclock earlier report before later. Delta contracts=current-prior; report positions are assumed previous cash dates. Distinct-time within-report deltas separate. Gaps not compressed; no opening/closing/dealer ownership inference.

clocks.asof: Retrospective source-clock scenario only: rows at/before cut, no future value. Unconditional causal eligible false. Preserve actual availability unknown. Latest eligible current/prior observed report with request_date<=cut date; report staleness and cohort date explicit.
clocks.assumptions: position_date_by_request=previous intended cash date of request_date; position_date_by_event=previous intended cash date of event Eastern date; separate diagnostics and mapping_agrees. source_clock_known_at_assumed_ns=ts_event_ns. Never elevate assumptions to verified clocks.
clocks.primary: known_at_ns,received_at_ns,published_at_ns,position_date are NULL; preserve original request_date and exact ts_event_ns. causal_feature_eligible FALSE.

source_document.paraphrase: Theta describes daily OPRA OI reports around 06:30 Eastern, reporting the preceding trading-day end. Missing new messages can occur. Its timestamp field description does not establish receipt or vintage.

coverage: Observed contracts/OI union and intersection each date; listings without OI, OI without listing, zeros, invalid negatives, missing clock, wrong requestdate, expired rows all distinct. Absence is never zero. No VIX nominal60DTE truncation; retain actual DTE and >60count.
duplicates: Same contract/request_date/time/value exact alias once, retain multiplicity. Same contract/time different values ambiguous (no winning row). Distinct-time differing values are observed update candidates, not certified revisions. First and last unique conflict-free source-clock values separate; no silent overwriting.
identity: chain+exact osi_symbol+expiration+strike+right. Preserve original source file ID and row ID separately from cross-date contract identity; never merge NDX/NDXP/SPX/SPXW. Conflicting same OSI metadata is invalid identity. Use original strike, no adjustment or notional multiplication.
labels: For every report endpoint retain next intended report endpoint or explicit missing/expiry/right-boundary censor. Next-report delta known only in assumed sourceclock at next endpoint; verified known_at NULL. Same-position update candidate differs from next-intended-report delta. Expiry date is a date-only lifecycle boundary, not invented settlement timestamp or forced zero.
operational_pilot: First 16 intended dates per chain; full gate scales measured CPU by max(source rows,source files,intended date units) with margin1.5 and60second fixed allowance. Output projection likewise; no science or threshold selection from pilot outcomes.

population.intended: Every cash date in inclusive range per chain; missing file/empty marker/row separately retained. VIX listing unknown. Daily contract snapshot is observed acquisition universe, not certified point-in-time listing.

remaining: OI report/lifecycle only; quotes/IV/flow/Greek exposures, actual ownership and futures-options source statistics remain separate pending branches. No Context fit.

statistics.metrics: OI level/zero fraction/coverage fraction; report clock seconds relative midnight Eastern and cut availability/staleness; next-adjacent-report delta/absolute delta/positive/zero/negative fractions; update-candidate fraction/difference and lifecycle censor fractions.
